title: Raw table transcription of formic-acid treatment responses in timothy-grass liquid fraction
publication: Grassland Science in Europe, Volume 29, Why grasslands?, pp. 128-130
license_status: No explicit reuse license identified in the proceedings; review redistribution rights.

basis_quality_gate.reason: The printed unit implies dry-matter, ash and protein quantities that cannot be reconciled with the article's reported protein-rich sediment mass per kg starting liquid; crude-protein and true-protein rows also exceed physically plausible component masses if interpreted literally on the stated fresh-liquid denominator. The table values are preserved exactly as printed, but no alternative denominator is inferred.
basis_quality_gate.rule: Do not interpret the values as component masses, concentrations, dimensionless recovery fractions, or model parameters until the authors or a corrected source clarify the denominator.

dose_basis_warning: The proceedings label the acid treatments 4-10 L/Mg, while the method states 0.2-0.5 ml pure acid per 500 g liquid, a tenfold discrepancy. Both are preserved in the companion dose/pH file; no acid demand is calculated here.
data_handling: Direct transcription of the four Table 1 response rows, five treatment means, SEM and linear/quadratic p-values. No unit conversion or derivation was performed.
limitations: Pure Finnish second-cut timothy-grass liquid is not GreenHub roadside-grass juice.
The experiment uses bottle-scale natural sedimentation rather than the GreenHub precipitation and centrifugation train.
Both the acid-dose basis and response-table denominator require source clarification; these data are quarantined and must not enter process calculations or TEA.
No explicit reuse license was identified in the proceedings PDF.
